hit_rule.description: Hit = the agent attempted a piped command (walked the path) and the tool result sent back to the model shows the pipe passed as a literal argument (e.g. `ls: cannot access '|'`, `find: paths must precede expression: `|'`, `'|': No such file`).

all.value: (cannot access '\||'\|': No such file|precede expression: .\|'|unknown predicate .\|'|ls: invalid option -- )
